resources.string: Browse an SMB share, or play a file or network stream with the VLC engine.
Folder indexing, filename and path search, and automatic topic/person shortcuts will be added once your SMB folder is configured.

Player gestures\nSwipe horizontally to preview a seek; drag down while seeking for frame-sized fine adjustment, then release to commit. Swipe up/down on the left for brightness, or on the right for volume. Double-tap the edges to skip 10 seconds; tap the center to show controls.
Open a direct media URL. For authenticated SMB media, use Browse SMB share on the home screen.
Enter a valid http, https, rtsp, rtsps, smb, ftp, ftps, udp or rtp URL without embedded credentials.
Controls locked. Tap Unlock to restore them.
Cannot play this media. Check that the file is accessible and the server is available. For SMB media, reconnect in the share browser if your login has changed.
Cannot open this file. Please choose it again.
The VLC playback engine could not start on this device.
No file picker is available on this device.
Another app is using audio. Try playing again.
This track could not be selected.
This stream does not support that playback speed.
Volume is fixed on this device.
Select a server to sign in and view its shares, or add a share manually. Discovery uses the current Wi-Fi or Ethernet network; it does not sign in.
Not listed? Some servers do not advertise themselves. Automatic IP checks cover up to 254 nearby addresses on port 445; use Add SMB Share for other subnets, VPNs, or custom ports.
Discovery complete. Select a server to browse its shares.
No SMB servers found. Check your network and server firewall, refresh, or add a share manually.
Discovery stopped. Refresh to search again.
Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet, then refresh. For a VPN server, use Add SMB Share.
Some discovery methods were unavailable. Results may be incomplete; refresh or add a share manually.
Allow local network access to discover SMB servers. If denied, enable it in Android app settings, then tap Refresh.
Enter a server to list its shares, or a full share/folder address to open it directly. Connect to the same network or VPN as your server.
Enter a server name, IP address, or smb://server/share/folder without credentials, queries, or parent-directory segments.
Enter a username or select guest access.
Credentials must not contain control characters.
No disk shares were returned. Disconnect and enter a full share address if the server hides its share list.
Login failed. Check your username, password and domain, or whether guest access is allowed. Disconnect first if already browsing.
Access denied. Check permissions with the server owner. If share listing is blocked, disconnect and enter the full share address.
The share or folder was not found. Check the address or refresh its parent folder.
Cannot reach the SMB server. Check the address, network/VPN and firewall, then retry. The server must support SMB2.
Cannot read this location. Try a full share address, refresh, or reconnect with another login.
This file is not a recognized media type. Try opening it with VLC anyway?
Your SMB session has ended. Return to the share browser and sign in again.
Local network access is required to connect to your SMB server. Allow it when asked, or in Android app settings, then tap Connect again.
